newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded as Q3 bids dip below 10 p/th.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded as Q3 bids dip below 10 p/th.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were untraded on Thursday morning, but bids and offers took their lead from the physical market and continued to tumble.
The 10 pence a therm mark has been broken on bids in the third quarter of this year.
By the close of the morning session, averaging out the months into quarters showed the range for Q3 at 9.89/10.14 pence a therm, Q4 12.85/13.33 pence a therm, and Q1 98 15.27/16.48 pence a therm.
Although the bid/offer spread on Q1 was unusually wide at over a penny a therm, the fact that it was bid at 15.27 pence showed a steep decline over recent days.
Volumes on futures have been thin all week, with only 60 lots traded so far.

Prices have consistently followed the OTC market, usually tracking it closely, and prices on both futures and physical have been soft since Tuesday, with physical traders saying producers are now offering gas aggressively.
